operations.specificationCeiling: O(lText + wPath + tOverride + sSelection + hHistory + cPolicy + qListener*cListener)

variables.name: lText
variables.meaning: code units copied by the prepared Content text edit

variables.name: wPath
variables.meaning: changed ancestor child-array widths copied by prepared structural sharing

variables.name: tOverride
variables.meaning: prepared changed-node overrides retained before the edit

variables.name: kID
variables.meaning: ID-bearing nodes retained by the prepared Content index

time.bound: O(lText + wPath + tOverride + sSelection + hHistory + cPolicy + qListener*cListener)

assumptions: the session was prepared and validated before the edit
the fast path accepts an empty inline surface or one canonical text run
application profile/policy and observer callback bodies are synchronous external work
ceilings: Content resource ceilings bound document and operation work
Editor history is bounded by MAX_EDITOR_HISTORY_LIMIT
deterministicWork: replaceText delegates document mutation to replacePreparedText
documentChanged is derived from the replaced source slice without whole-document equality
selection/history/publication remain Editor-owned bounded follow-up work
contract.resourceRationale: Prepared text editing reuses Content retained indexes and structurally shared documents. Local history stores immutable document references; repeated edits may retain copied changed-container arrays up to the configured history bound.
contract.proof: The session performs one prepared Content edit, maps and validates selection, runs synchronous guards, updates bounded local history, and publishes once without semantic transformDocument or whole-document equality.
contract.adversarialWitness: The Editor session benchmark measures about 0.19 ms for one prepared replaceText at 50k root paragraphs after preparation.

fullScan.rationale: Prepared text edits must not scan or compare the full document after preparation.

operations.specificationCeiling: O(oOp*nNode + nNode + nValue + sSelection + hHistory + cPolicy + qListener*cListener)

variables.name: nNode
variables.meaning: Portable Content nodes in the current/candidate document

variables.name: kID
variables.meaning: ID-bearing nodes retained by the resulting prepared Content index

time.bound: O(oOp*nNode + nNode + nValue + sSelection + hHistory + cPolicy + qListener*cListener)

assumptions: semantic Content transformDocument may rebuild indexes per operation
history entries retain immutable document generations up to the configured bound
ceilings: Content operation/node/value/depth ceilings bound semantic work
Editor history is bounded by MAX_EDITOR_HISTORY_LIMIT
deterministicWork: one Editor transaction delegates its bounded operation batch to Content transformDocument
the accepted candidate is prepared once
selection, policy, history and publication run only after Content succeeds
contract.resourceRationale: General semantic transactions prioritize atomic correctness over the prepared typing fast path. Snapshot history can retain full semantic document generations and is explicitly bounded.
contract.proof: The path executes one bounded Content operation batch, prepares the accepted candidate, updates Editor state and publishes at most one session generation.
contract.adversarialWitness: The Editor benchmark measures roughly 51 ms for one semantic transaction at 10k root paragraphs in the proof environment.

fullScan.rationale: The general semantic transaction path may validate/materialize the full candidate; plain typing uses the prepared fast path.
